title: Release performance improvements to adopters
outOfScope: Modifying, moving, deleting, rebuilding, or re-publishing v0.5.50 or any existing semantic tag/provider Release.
Manual creation of tags, Releases, or public assets; only the authoritative release.yml workflow may perform immutable provider mutations.
Claiming that a specific existing adopter was upgraded; this Work Item proves the published future-adopter installation path only.
Weakening quality, release, identity, installer, coverage, or supply-chain gates.

sources.reason: Records the merged performance improvements and the source-bound acceptance evidence that the new public template version must carry.
Canonical tag reservation and projection state; v0.5.50 is published/reserved so v0.5.51 is the only eligible successor.
Candidate projection to advance to v0.5.51.
Authoritative same-SHA rehearsal, immutable tag/Release creation, asset publication, and tagged Quick Install verification.
Canonical future-adopter Quick Install and upgrade distribution contract.
User clarified that delivery means future installed adopter projects, and authorized necessary confirmations to be recorded in the Contract.

rawUserRequest: 将已验收的性能收益交付给未来安装的 adopter 工程；不要修改 v0.5.50。用户授权必要确认并要求写入 Contract。

authorityEvidence.scope: Publish only v0.5.51 after candidate readiness, exact-SHA rehearsal, hosted checks, authoritative provider workflow, immutable tag/Release/assets, and post-publication tagged Quick Install verification pass. No gate bypass, historical tag mutation, or blind retry is authorized.

declaredIntent.summary: Publish v0.5.51 and prove that a future adopter can install the released template through the public, immutable distribution path.

riskAssessment.reason: The Work Item creates an immutable public release and must prove its installer path for future adopters against one exact default-branch source and tag.

reasons: Public immutable release and installer-distribution verification require strict release governance.

override.approvalEvidence: User authorized necessary confirmations and required they be recorded in the Contract while directing performance benefit delivery to future adopter installations.
override.reason: Immutable public release and post-publication installer verification require strict governance.
notRunChecks: No required verification is omitted; immutable provider publication checks run only after the release-preparation PR merges and are recorded as external release evidence.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized the governed publication and required its future-adopter benefit to be proven by the released installation path.

preReviewWarnings: v0.5.50 is immutable historical release evidence and must not be rewritten.
A green outcome requires post-publication tagged Quick Install evidence, not merely a merged release-preparation PR.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Canonical metadata advances only to v0.5.51, one patch after the highest immutable v0.5.50 tag; all earlier tags and provider Releases remain immutable.

The premerge candidate is internally consistent: release-state.json, release.json, next-release.json, version.json, freeze, release-digests, SBOM, and provenance pass the release checks without claiming public publication before it occurs.
The Work Item is archived, merged, and the exact merged origin/main SHA has successful smoke and compatibility evidence before release dispatch.
A same-SHA release.yml rehearsal for v0.5.51 succeeds and produces a receipt while creating no tag, provider Release, or public asset.

The authoritative release.yml publication succeeds using that exact rehearsal receipt, creates only v0.5.51, and proves exact tag target, release assets, SBOM/provenance/digests, installer identity, and final strict smoke.
A clean future-adopter installation from the published v0.5.51 Release succeeds through the tagged Quick Install path and verifies the installed version-bound lifecycle/quality surface.

Any missing, stale, mismatched, failed, cancelled, or incomplete release/adopter-installation evidence ends with yellow/red Outcome and recovery conditions; only complete evidence allows green closure.
guidelines: Use only the authoritative release workflow for immutable provider mutations; never create tags or Releases manually.
Preserve strict readiness, same-SHA rehearsal, publication, and post-publication installer verification ordering; fail closed on identity mismatch.
Treat future-adopter delivery as a verified public tagged-install path, not as a claim based only on merged source or a local fixture.
Record user authorization, red/yellow failure recovery, and green completion evidence truthfully in Contract, Summary, Outcome, and archive.

intent.problem: The performance Work Item is merged and closed on template main, but future adopter projects consume only published immutable template releases. Without a successor release and tagged installation proof, the measured speed improvements are unavailable to those projects.
constraints: Do not change or rebuild v0.5.50, and never reuse a reserved semantic version.
Release only through the repository release.yml workflow after exact-source same-SHA rehearsal and fresh hosted checks.
Do not claim a named existing adopter upgrade; prove the public installation path intended for future adopters.
Retain all quality, coverage, security, supply-chain, Outcome, receipt, and recovery gates.
intent.rationale: A public immutable release plus its actual tagged Quick Install verification is the stable distribution boundary that makes the validated template performance behavior available to future adopter projects.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Release metadata attempts to reuse v0.5.50 or has inconsistent published/candidate projections.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Release readiness fails before provider dispatch; only v0.5.51 is eligible.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run release state, distribution, and preflight checks with focused regression tests.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A rehearsal source/tag differs from the merged default-branch source or creates public/immutable release state.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The workflow fails closed or records a private same-SHA receipt without a v0.5.51 tag/Release.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Dispatch release.yml rehearsal and validate its receipt plus provider tag/Release absence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Publication has a stale or mismatched rehearsal, failed dependent checks, incomplete assets, or mismatched source identity.
scenarioCoverage.expected: release.yml refuses public promotion and records an actionable failure condition.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use workflow regression coverage and inspect the actual release run evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A future adopter installs from the public v0.5.51 tag but receives incomplete, mismatched, or non-executable runtime files.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Tagged Quick Install fails closed; green delivery requires a clean installation receipt and installed lifecycle/quality verification.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the workflow's tagged Quick Install result and run the repository published distribution verifier after publication.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized necessary confirmations and required the authorization to be recorded in the Contract; immutable publication remains restricted to release.yml after all fail-closed gates pass.

rollbackNote: Before publication, revert the candidate metadata through this Work Item. After immutable publication, never retag/delete/move v0.5.51; preserve evidence and use a separate corrective Work Item.
